gen-gf-autour-one-gf-port-lligat-sans: Autour One draws a clear channel into every round letter, with no hairline-to-stem shift anywhere. Port Lligat Sans packs its characters close and leaves bowls open on one side, so paragraphs move along in a dense, modern stream.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-ramabhadra: Ramabhadra reads tall and clean, its prominent x-height filling the line with lowercase. And Autour One crosses its t with a bar as heavy as the stem, giving a long page a bold, expressive lead.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-rambla: Big, round and confident, with every o a ring of constant wall. Rambla keeps its small letters nearly as tall as capitals, so extended text feels sturdy and uncluttered.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-recursive: Autour One's round letters each get a clear channel in, and the whole face stays bold and expressive. Recursive follows with a tall mean line and strokes that never thin out by direction, which makes long reading feel approachable.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-roboto-condensed: Roboto Condensed runs tight, with barely visible gaps inside each word and an enlarged lowercase that glides under the eye like wire. And Autour One gives it a bold, expressive foil, which is exactly where the pair gets its pull.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-saira-semi-condense: Autour One is loud, round and expressive. Saira Semi Condensed looks magnified without changing size and holds a steady weight from word to word, and that quiet, modern consistency is what the pair does best.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-secular-one: Fat, friendly and unmistakably display. Autour One earns its keep when big and short, while Secular One answers with a dominant midsection and zero modulation, a plain sans that feels modern and businesslike.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-smooch-sans: Smooch Sans reads tight and high-waisted. Its s opens generously at the bends while the line stays packed, and Autour One's pressure-free, ballpoint-like weight gives the page a bold, rounded anchor above it.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-sofia-sans-condense: Round, loud and a bit playful. Autour One brings the bold swagger, while Sofia Sans Condensed adds a big x-height, unfinished loops and no calligraphic shading, so the two feel approachable and contemporary together.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-spline-sans-mono: Autour One's round letters each get a clear channel in, which is its most distinctive habit. Spline Sans Mono is fixed-width and precise with lowercase nearly matching capitals, so shrinking the heading would let that technical body take over.
